prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: one Chrome Web Store discovery tile, landscape 11:7 composition, intended 1760x1120 pixels, never panoramic.
Create a sophisticated absolutely TEXT-FREE diagram for a browser extension that overlays live chat inside fullscreen video.
Design 10: full-bleed soft ivory background. A single large flat charcoal video rectangle floats centrally with generous clean outer margin, occupying 83% width and 70% height. At the FOUR OUTERMOST corners put elegant red fullscreen L-brackets, enclosing the complete video INCLUDING its chat on right. Two slim geometric coral bars cross the video horizontally, passing visibly BEHIND the semi-transparent inset chat. A crisp small red play triangle sits slightly left of center. The chat is a floating warm-white translucent rectangle within the video's right quarter, inset on ALL sides from the video edges. It has four roomy native-style comment rows, each a small circular avatar and two tiny simple horizontal geometric strokes, not real text. Bottom of chat has a thin rounded composer outline and tiny triangular send icon. Precise elegant spacing, restrained Swiss graphic design, flat editorial vector-like finish, sharp edges, no glossy material or shadows. The relationship must be immediate: entire video becomes fullscreen while chat remains visibly OVER the picture. Chat not a separate sidebar, fullscreen corners at farthest right outside chat, no seam.
Text: NONE. No words, letters, numbers, logos, product name, pseudo-letters or watermark. Only play/fullscreen/chat symbols and pure message strokes. NO mountains, sun, landscape, people, scenery, gradients, monitor hardware, browser chrome, extra cards, 3D, plastic, glow, decorative stars, metrics or captions.
